preToolUse.command: command -v dent8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; if [ -f .dent8/env ]; then set -a; . .dent8/env; set +a; fi; DENT8_HOOK_MODE=guard-native-memory-write DENT8_HOOK_ENFORCE=1 dent8 hook native-memory-guard

postToolUse.command: command -v dent8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; if [ -f .dent8/env ]; then set -a; . .dent8/env; set +a; fi; DENT8_HOOK_MODE=post-write-audit dent8 hook native-memory-guard

stop.command: command -v dent8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; if [ -f .dent8/env ]; then set -a; . .dent8/env; set +a; fi; dent8 capture .dent8/proposals.jsonl --consume --keep-failed
